strategic.definition: Clarity, fairness, and competitiveness of all fees, rates, and price changes across the customer lifecycle.

midlevel.definition: Disclosure, justification, and communication of fees, rates, and price changes.
midlevel.name: Fee & rate transparency

specific.definition: Presence, clarity, and justification of establishment, administration, instalment, and other fees tied to invoice financing and account use.
specific.name: Unexplained or undisclosed fees

specific.definition: Whether quoted, displayed, or calculator-based rates match the effective interest costs customers ultimately face.
specific.name: Quoted vs effective rate consistency

specific.definition: Clarity of fee structures and correctness of fee invoicing in day-to-day operations.
specific.name: Fee complexity and invoice accuracy

specific.definition: Whether and how far in advance customers are informed of interest-rate changes on existing facilities.
specific.name: Rate-change notice on existing facilities

midlevel.definition: How customers perceive total cost relative to alternatives and competitors.
midlevel.name: Pricing competitiveness

specific.definition: Overall value perception weighing interest rates against add-on fees compared to alternative financing providers.
specific.name: Rate vs fee trade-off vs competitors

strategic.name: Pricing & Fees

strategic.definition: Usability, reliability, feature breadth, and integration depth of the online portal, mobile app, and self-service tools.

midlevel.definition: Speed, stability, and feature completeness of the online banking portal and mobile app.
midlevel.name: Portal usability & performance

specific.definition: Portal responsiveness, uptime, and freedom from crashes or incorrect balance displays.
specific.name: Portal speed and reliability

specific.definition: Breadth of features available in the online portal and mobile app, including gaps in app scope versus web.
specific.name: Portal feature completeness

specific.definition: Ease of login, authentication friction, and access to the digital channel.
specific.name: Login friction and access issues

midlevel.definition: Whether digital channels can resolve issues independently and at all hours.
midlevel.name: Self-service & digital resolution

specific.definition: Effectiveness of chatbot, app, and portal self-service tools in resolving customer issues without human escalation.
specific.name: Chatbot and portal self-service capability

midlevel.definition: Reliability and depth of third-party connections and access controls within digital tools.
midlevel.name: Integrations & access control

specific.definition: Reliability and setup ease of connections to accounting platforms such as Bokfør, including automated invoice flow.
specific.name: Accounting software connectivity

specific.definition: Granularity of role-based access control and accountant access within the bank's digital tools.
specific.name: User permission and role-based access

specific.definition: Availability and functional scope of the mobile app relative to the web portal.
specific.name: Mobile app availability and scope

strategic.name: Digital Experience & Platform

strategic.definition: Speed, accessibility, expertise, and continuity of customer-facing staff and support channels.

midlevel.definition: Speed and ease of reaching human help across phone, email, and chat channels.
midlevel.name: Support response & accessibility

specific.definition: Timeliness and reliability of replies to customer inquiries across email, chat, and case-management systems.
specific.name: Support reply speed across channels

specific.definition: Phone queue lengths, callback reliability, and ease of reaching a human agent.
specific.name: Phone queue wait and reachability

midlevel.definition: Quality of advice, problem-solving attitude, and consistency of answers across staff.
midlevel.name: Staff helpfulness & advisory quality

specific.definition: Solution-orientation, expertise, and willingness of advisors to help solve customer problems.
specific.name: Advisor solution-orientation

specific.definition: Tone, accuracy, and consistency of staff responses across phone, email, and chat channels.
specific.name: Staff tone and reply consistency

midlevel.definition: Continuity of named advisor relationships and case handover quality.
midlevel.name: Advisor continuity & case handover

specific.definition: Availability of a named advisor and whether case handovers cause repeated information requests or restarts.
